exact_result: Unverified author proof draft: for every complete nontrivially valued K, every separable quadratic E/K, and every good separated strict boundaryless pure n-dimensional K-analytic space (n >= 1), including singular and nonreduced structures, the ordinary CLD zero-Hessian equation of every continuous finite h automatically ascends to X_E and is equivalent there to the ground-field equation. This includes Q2(sqrt2)/Q2 without a residue-separating unit and iterates through finite quadratic towers. Fixed-support differentiated total-variation approximation of invariant compact ordinary (n-1,n-1) tests is proved, rather than exact ramified ordinary form descent.
concrete_gaps: Original P06.2 classical recognition on arbitrary good separated strict boundaryless spaces and ordinary two-sign current-positive regularization remain unproved; no original strict analytic counterexample is claimed.
Scalar-current ascent through general finite separable extensions outside finite quadratic towers, completed infinite algebraic extensions and transcendental analytic extensions remains unproved.
Universal classical curve-test quantifiers over all analytic extensions remain untreated; the new scalar gate alone does not supply recognition.
Exact invariant ordinary smooth form descent and preservation of positive test cones are not claimed; positive-current ascent and ordinary harmonic approximation remain separate.
The draft has a fallible author self-audit and finite build/diagnostic evidence only, with no independent mathematical verification or inherited parent verdict.
